title.zh: 【三星钱包与 Sui 达成合作，支持 Sui 上 USDC 转账】
title.en: 【三星钱包与 Sui 达成合作，支持 Sui 上 USDC 转账】

current_state.zh: Sui and Samsung Wallet partnered to enable gasless USDC transfers on Sui for Galaxy device users in the US, with only USDC supported initially and no support for the SUI token.
current_state.en: Sui and Samsung Wallet partnered to enable gasless USDC transfers on Sui for Galaxy device users in the US, with only USDC supported initially and no support for the SUI token.
